Dalman, Words, 234ff.; DB, iv, 579ff.; DCG, ii, 659ff.; Westc., St. John, i, 74ff.; other reff. in Swete, Mk, 2:10), based on the Aram. of [[daniel 7 13|Dan.7:13]], where the phrase, like the corresponding Heb. (as in [[psalms 8 5|Psa.8:5]]), means a man, one of the species, and indicates the human appearance of the person in question. It is used of the Messiah in Enoch, with 46, §1-4, also in II [[esther 13 3|Est.13:3, 12]], al. Our Lord first makes the phrase a title, using the def. art. It seems to combine the ideas of his true humanity and representative character. Exc. in [[acts 7 56|Act.7:56]] and (anarth.) [[revelation 1 13|Rev.1:13]] [[revelation 14 14|14:14]], it is used of Jesus only by himself: [[matthew 8 20|Mat.8:20]], [[mark 2 10|Mrk.2:10]], [[luke 5 24|Luk.5:24]], [[john 1 52|Jhn.1:52]], al. (AS)

(Bl., § 79, 4), [[matthew 5 34|Mat.5:34 8:4 18:15 19:21 21:28 27:65 28:10]], [[mark 1 44|Mrk.1:44 10:21 16:7]], [[john 4 16|Jhn.4:16 9:7]], [[revelation 10 8|Rev.10:8]]; with καί inserted, [[revelation 16 1|Rev.16:1;]] euphemistically, of death, [[matthew 26 24|Mat.26:24]], [[mark 14 21|Mrk.14:21]]; with adv.: ποῦ (which see), [[john 12 35|Jhn.12:35 14:5 16:5]], [[1-john 2 11|1Jn.2:11]]; ὅπου (which see), [[john 8 21|Jhn.8:21-22 13:33, 36 14:4]] [[revelation 14 4|Rev.14:4]]; ἐκεῖ, [[john 11 8|Jhn.11:8;]] with prep.: πρός, [[john 7 33|Jhn.7:33 13:3 16:5, 10 16:17]]; εἰς, [[matthew 9 6|Mat.9:6 20:4, 7]], [[mark 2 11|Mrk.2:11 11:2 14:13]], [[luke 19 30|Luk.19:30]], [[john 6 21|Jhn.6:21 7:3 9:11 11:31]], [[revelation 13 10|Rev.13:10 17:8, 11]]; εἰς . . . πρός, [[matthew 26 18|Mat.26:18]], [[mark 5 19|Mrk.5:19]]; ἐπί, [[luke 12 58|Luk.12:58;]] μετά, [[matthew 5 41|Mat.5:41;]] ὀπίσω, [[matthew 16 23|Mat.16:23]], [[mark 8 33|Mrk.8:33]]; with inf., [[john 21 3|Jhn.21:3.]]† (AS)

ὑπακοή, -ῆς, ἡ (ὑπακούω), [in LXX: [[2-samuel 22 36|2Ki.22:36]] (עֲנָוָה); in Aq.: [[2-samuel 23 23|2Ki.23:23]] * ;] obedience (opposite to παρακοή); 1. in general, absol., εἰς ὑ., [[romans 6 16|Rom.6:16;]] with genitive subjc., [[2-corinthians 7 15|2Co.7:15 10:6]], Phm 21; with genitive obj., [[romans 1 5|Rom.1:5]] (Lft, Notes, 246) [[romans 16 26|Rom.16:26]], [[1-peter 1 22|1Pe.1:22]]; τ. Χριστοῦ, [[2-corinthians 10 5|2Co.10:5.]] 2. Of obedience to God's commands: absol., [[1-peter 1 2|1Pe.1:2;]] opposite to ἁμαρτία, [[romans 6 16|Rom.6:16;]] τέκνα ὑπακοῆς, [[1-peter 1 14|1Pe.1:14;]] with genitive subj., [[romans 15 18|Rom.15:18 16:19]]. 3. Of Christ's obedience: absol., [[hebrews 5 8|Heb.5:8;]] with genitive subj., [[romans 5 19|Rom.5:19.]] (The word is not found except in LXX, NT and eccl.).† (AS)

ὑπακούω [in LXX: chiefly for שָׁמַע ;] to listen, attend, hence, (a) to answer a knock at a door (Plat., Xen., al.): [[acts 12 13|Act.12:13;]] (b) to attend to, submit to, obey (Hdt., Thuc., al.): absol., [[philippians 2 12|Php.2:12;]] with inf., [[hebrews 11 8|Heb.11:8;]] with dative of person(s) (Plat., al.; but more frequently with genitive), [[matthew 8 27|Mat.8:27]], [[mark 1 27|Mrk.1:27 4:41]], [[luke 8 25|Luk.8:25 17:6]], [[romans 6 16|Rom.6:16]], [[ephesians 6 1|Eph.6:1]], 5, [[colossians 3 20|Col.3:20, 22]], [[hebrews 5 9|Heb.5:9]], [[1-peter 3 6|1Pe.3:6]]; with dative of thing(s), [[acts 6 7|Act.6:7]], [[romans 6 12|Rom.6:12 10:16]], [[2-thessalonians 1 8|2Th.1:8 3:14]]; before εἰς (by attraction, for dative; see ICC, in l), [[romans 6 17|Rom.6:17.]]† (AS)

ὕπανδρος, -ον [in LXX: [[numbers 5 20|Num.5:20, 29]] (אִישׁ תַּחַת), [[proverbs 6 24|Pro.6:24, 29]], Sir.9:9 41:21 * ;] under or subject to a man, married: γυνή, [[romans 7 2|Rom.7:2]] (Polyb., Diod., al.).† (AS)

ὑπ-αντάω, -ῶ [in LXX: Dan LXX 10:14 (קָרָה), Sir.9:3, al. ;] to go to meet, meet: with dative of person(s) (see M, Pr., 64), [[matthew 8 28|Mat.8:28 28:9]], [[mark 5 2|Mrk.5:2]], [[luke 8 27|Luk.8:27 17:12]] (ἀπ-, WH, txt.), [[john 4 51|Jhn.4:51 11:20, 30 12:18]], [[acts 16 16|Act.16:16]]; of meeting in battle, [[luke 14 31|Luk.14:31.]]† (AS)

ὑπ-άντησις, -εως, ἡ (ὑπαντάω), [in LXX: [[judges 11 34|Jdg.11:34]], εἰς ὑ. (קִרְאָה), etc. ;] a going to meet: εἰς ὑ. (see M, [[proverbs 14 1|Pro.14:1-35]] n), [[matthew 8 34|Mat.8:34 25:1]], [[john 12 13|Jhn.12:13]].† (AS)

ὕπαρξις, -εως, ἡ (ὑπάρχω), [in LXX for רְכוּשׁ, הוֹן, etc. ;] 1. subsistence, existence (Arist., al.). 2. In late writers, = τὰ ὑπάρχοντα, substance, property: [[hebrews 10 34|Heb.10:34;]] pl., [[acts 2 45|Act.2:45.]]† (AS)

to have, possess; (n.) possessions; to be, exist to begin; to come into existence; to exist; to be, subsist, [[acts 19 40|Acts 19:40;]] 28:18; to be in possession, to belong, [[acts 3 6|Acts 3:6;]] 4:37; goods, possessions, property, [[matthew 19 21|Mt. 19:21]]; [[luke 8 3|Lk. 8:3]]; to be, [[luke 7 25|Lk. 7:25; 8:41]]

ὑπάρχω [in LXX for הָיָה, יֵשׁ, לוּן, etc.; τ. ὑπάρχοντα for מִקְנֶה, רְכוּשׁ, etc. ;] 1. to begin, make a beginning (Hom., Hdt., al.). 2. to be in existence, be ready, be at hand (Hdt., Thuc., al.): [[acts 19 40|Act.19:40 27:12, 21]]; before ἐν, [[acts 28 18|Act.28:18.]] 3. to be, prop, expressing continuance of an antecedent state or condition (cf. Gifford, Incarnation, 11 ff.; MM, xxv): with, nom, pred., [[luke 8 41|Luk.8:41 9:48]], [[acts 4 34|Act.4:34 7:55 8:16 16:3 19:36 21:20]], [[1-corinthians 7 26|1Co.7:26 12:22]], [[james 2 15|Jas.2:15]], [[2-peter 3 11|2Pe.3:11]]; ptcp. with pred., [[luke 16 14|Luk.16:14 23:50]], [[acts 2 30|Act.2:30, 32 17:24 22:3]], [[romans 4 19|Rom.4:19]], [[1-corinthians 2 15|1Co.2:15]], [[2-corinthians 8 17|2Co.8:17 12:16]], [[galatians 1 14|Gal.1:14 2:14]]; pl., [[luke 11 13|Luk.11:13]], [[acts 16 20|Act.16:20, 37 17:29]], [[2-peter 2 19|2Pe.2:19]]; before ἐν, with dative of thing(s), [[luke 7 25|Luk.7:25 16:23]], [[acts 5 4|Act.5:4 10:12]], [[1-corinthians 11 18|1Co.11:18]], [[philippians 3 20|Php.3:20]]; ἐν μορφῇ θεοῦ ὑπάρχων (R, mg., being originally), [[philippians 2 6|Php.2:6;]] ἐν, with dative of person(s), (among), [[1-corinthians 11 18|1Co.11:18;]] μακρὰν ἀπό, [[acts 17 27|Act.17:27;]] πρὸς τ. σωτηρίας, [[acts 27 34|Act.27:34.]] 4. to belong to (Thuc., Xen., al.): with dative of person(s), [[acts 3 6|Act.3:6 4:37 28:7]], [[2-peter 1 8|2Pe.1:8]]; τὰ ὑπάρχοντα, one's belongings, possessions: with dative of person(s), [[luke 8 3|Luk.8:3 12:15]], [[acts 4 32|Act.4:32]]; with genitive of person(s), [[matthew 19 21|Mat.19:21 24:47 25:14]], [[luke 11 21|Luk.11:21 12:33, 44 14:33 16:1 19:8]], [[1-corinthians 13 3|1Co.13:3]], [[hebrews 10 34|Heb.10:34]] (cf. προ-υπάρχω).† (AS)
ὑπ-είκω [in LXX: 4Ma.6:35 * ;] 1. to retire, withdraw. 2. to yield, submit: metaphorically, [[hebrews 13 17|Heb.13:17.]]† (AS)

ὑπ-εναντίος, -α, -ον [in LXX for אָיַב, צַר, etc. ;] set over against, opposite. Metaphorical (Plat., Arist., al.), opposed to, contrary to: with dative of person(s), [[colossians 2 14|Col.2:14;]] absol., as subst., ὁ ὑ., [[hebrews 10 27|Heb.10:27]] (cf. [[isaiah 26 11|Isa.26:11]]).† (AS)

ὑπέρ (when following subst.—poët.—ὕπερ; so as adv., [[2-corinthians 11 23|2Co.11:23]]), prep. with genitive, accusative I. C. genitive, primarily of place (rest or motion), over, above, across, beyond, hence, metaphorically, 1. for, on behalf of: of prayer, [[matthew 5 44|Mat.5:44]], [[acts 8 24|Act.8:24]], [[romans 10 1|Rom.10:1]], [[james 5 16|Jas.5:16]], al.; of laying down life, [[john 10 11|Jhn.10:11]], [[romans 9 3|Rom.9:3]], al.; esp. of Christ giving his life for man's redemption, [[mark 14 24|Mrk.14:24]], [[john 10 15|Jhn.10:15]], [[acts 21 13|Act.21:13]], [[romans 5 6|Rom.5:6-8]], al.; opposite to κατά, [[mark 9 40|Mrk.9:40]], [[luke 9 50|Luk.9:50]], [[romans 8 31|Rom.8:31]]. 2. Causal, for, because of, for the sake of: with genitive of person(s), [[acts 5 41|Act.5:41]], [[romans 1 5|Rom.1:5]], [[philippians 1 29|Php.1:29]], [[2-corinthians 12 10|2Co.12:10]], al.; with genitive of thing(s), [[john 11 4|Jhn.11:4]], [[romans 15 8|Rom.15:8]], [[2-corinthians 1 6|2Co.1:6]], al. 3. = ἀντί (see M, Pr., 105), for, instead of, in the name of: [[1-corinthians 15 29|1Co.15:29]], [[2-corinthians 5 15|2Co.5:15, 21]] [[galatians 3 13|Gal.3:13]], [[colossians 1 7|Col.1:7]], Phm 13 (cf. Field, Notes, 225). 4. In more colourless sense, = περί (M, Pr., l.with), for, concerning, with regard to: [[romans 9 27|Rom.9:27]], [[2-corinthians 1 6|2Co.1:6 8:23 12:8]], [[philippians 1 7|Php.1:7]], [[2-thessalonians 2 1|2Th.2:1]], al. II. C. accusative, primarily of place, over, beyond, across, hence, metaphorically, of measure or degree in excess, above, beyond, over, more than: [[matthew 10 24|Mat.10:24, 37]] [[luke 6 40|Luk.6:40]], [[acts 26 13|Act.26:13]], [[1-corinthians 10 13|1Co.10:13]], [[2-corinthians 1 8|2Co.1:8]], [[ephesians 1 22|Eph.1:22 3:20]], Phm 16, al.; after comparatives = than ([[judges 11 25|Jdg.11:25]], al.), [[luke 16 8|Luk.16:8]], [[hebrews 4 12|Heb.4:12]]. III. As adv. (see supr. ad init.), more: ὕπερ ἐγώ, I more, [[2-corinthians 11 23|2Co.11:23;]] in compounds, see: ὑπεράνω, ὑπερλίαν, ὑπερπερισσῶς. IV. In composition: over (ὑπεραίρω), beyond (ὑπερβάλλω), more (ὐπερνικάω), on behalf of (ὐπερεντυγχάνω). (AS)

ὑπερ-αίρω [in LXX: [[2-chronicles 32 23|2Ch.32:23]] (נָשָׂא ni.), etc. ;] to lift or raise over. Mid., to uplift oneself: [[2-corinthians 12 7|2Co.12:7;]] before ἐπί, with accusative, of person(s), [[2-thessalonians 2 4|2Th.2:4]] (cf. 2Ma.5:23).† (AS)
ὑπέρακμος, -ον past the bloom of youth: [[1-corinthians 7 36|1Co.7:36]] (Eustath.).† (AS)
ὑπερ-άνω compound adv., [in LXX for עַל, מֵעָל, etc. ;] above: as prep. with genitive, [[ephesians 1 21|Eph.1:21 4:10]], [[hebrews 9 5|Heb.9:5]].† (AS)
ὑπερ-αυξάνω to increase beyond measure: [[2-thessalonians 1 3|2Th.1:3]] (see Lft., Notes, 98).† (AS)

ὑπερ-βαίνω [in LXX for עָבַר, etc. ;] 1. trans., to step over, trans­gress (R, overreach: [[1-thessalonians 4 6|1Th.4:6]]). 2. Intrans., to transgress: metaphorically, [[1-thessalonians 4 6|1Th.4:6]] (R, txt.; see M, Th., in l).† (AS)
ὑπερβαλλόντως [in LXX: [[job 15 11|Job.15:11]] א B (†) * ;] above measure: [[2-corinthians 11 23|2Co.11:23.]]† (AS)

ὑπερ-βάλλω [in LXX: [[job 15 11|Job.15:11]] A (†), Sir.5:7 25:11, al. ;] 1. trans., to throw over or beyond. 2. Intrans., to run beyond. In both senses, metaphorically, to exceed, surpass, transcend: [[2-corinthians 3 10|2Co.3:10 9:14]], [[ephesians 1 19|Eph.1:19 2:7]]; with genitive obj., [[ephesians 3 19|Eph.3:19.]]† (AS)

ὑπερ-βολή, -ῆς, ἡ (ὑπερβάλλω), [in LXX: καθ᾽ ὑ., 4Ma.3:18 * ;] a throwing beyond. Metaphorical, excess, superiority, excellence: [[2-corinthians 4 7|2Co.4:7 12:7]]; καθ᾽ ὑπερβολήν, beyond measure, exceedingly, [[romans 7 13|Rom.7:13]], [[1-corinthians 12 31|1Co.12:31]], [[2-corinthians 1 8|2Co.1:8]], [[galatians 1 13|Gal.1:13]]; κ. ὑ. εἰς ὑ., beyond all measure, [[2-corinthians 4 17|2Co.4:17.]]† (AS)
ὑπερ-εῖδον, aor. [in LXX for עָלַם hi., מַעַל, etc. ;] to overlook: with accusative of thing(s), [[acts 17 30|Act.17:30]] (AS)
ὑπερ-έκεινα comp. adv. (see Bl., 28, 2; M, Pr., 99), beyond: as prep. with genitive, τὰ ὑ. ὑμῶν, [[2-corinthians 10 16|2Co.10:16]] (Byz. and [[ecclesiastes 1 1|Ecc.1:1-18.]]).† (AS)
ὑπερ-εκ-τείνω to stretch out overmuch: metaphorically, ἑαυτούς, [[2-corinthians 10 14|2Co.10:14.]]† (AS)
ὑπερ-εκ-χύννω (Rec. -ύνω), late form of -χέω to pour out over. Pass., to overflow, run over: [[luke 6 38|Luk.6:38]] (not elsewhere).† (AS)
ὑπερ-εν-τυγχάνω to intercede or make petition for (see Deiss., BS, 121 f.): before ὑπέρ, [[romans 8 26|Rom.8:26.]]† (AS)

ὑπερ-έχω [in LXX: [[genesis 25 23|Gen.25:23]] (אָמַץ), [[exodus 26 13|Exo.26:13]] (עֲדַף), Sir.36:7, al. ;] 1. trans., to hold over or above. 2. Intrans. (when a noun follows, the case is governed by the prep.; see Bl., § 34, 1; 36, 8), to rise above, overtop; metaphorically, (a) to be superior in rank, etc.: [[romans 13 1|Rom.13:1]], [[1-peter 2 13|1Pe.2:13]] (cf. Wis.6:6); (b) to be superior, excel, surpass: with genitive (cl.; see supr.), [[philippians 2 3|Php.2:3;]] with accusative (cl.; see supr.), [[philippians 4 7|Php.4:7;]] as subst., τ. ὑπερέχον, the excel­lency, the surpassing worth, [[philippians 3 8|Php.3:8.]]† (AS)
ὑπερηφανία, -ας, ἡ (ὑπερήφανος, which see), [in LXX chiefly for גָּאוֹן and cogn. forms ;] haughtiness, arrogance, disdain: [[mark 7 22|Mrk.7:22]] (Plat., Xen.).† (AS)

ὑπερήφανος, -ον (ὑπέρ, φαίνομαι, with η pleonast., see Kühner3, I, 189) [in LXX for זֵד, גֵּאֶה, לוּץ, etc. ;] showing oneself above others; (a) in good sense (Plat., al.), pre-eminent, splendid; (b) more frequently in had sense, and so always in Scr., arrogant, haughty, disdainful (see Westc. Epp. Jo., 65b): [[romans 1 30|Rom.1:30]], [[2-timothy 3 2|2Ti.3:2]]; διανοίᾳ καρδίας, [[luke 1 51|Luk.1:51;]] opposite to ταπεινός (as in [[proverbs 3 34|Pro.3:34]]), [[james 4 6|Jas.4:6]], [[1-peter 5 5|1Pe.5:5]]" (LXX) .† SYN.: ἀλαζών, ὑβριστής, see Tr., Syn., § xxix (AS)
ὑπερ-νικάω, -ῶ [in LXX: Da TH [[daniel 6 3|Dan.6:3;]] in Sm.: [[psalms 43 1|Psa.43:1]] * ;] to be more than conqueror: [[romans 8 37|Rom.8:37]] (eccl.).† (AS)

ὑπέρ-ογκος, -ον [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 30 11|Deu.30:11]] (פָּלָא), etc. ;] of excessive weight or size; metaphorically, excessive, immoderate, in late writers, of arrogant speech (see Mayor on Ju, l.with): n. pl., [[2-peter 2 18|2Pe.2:18]], Ju 16.† (AS)

ὑπεροχή, -ῆς, ἡ (ὑπερέχω) [in LXX: [[jeremiah 52 22|Jer.52:22]] (קוֹמָה), 2Ma.3:11, al. ;] a projection, eminence, as the peak of a mountain. Metaphorical (Arist.), excellence, pre-eminence: λόγου ἢ σοφίας, [[1-corinthians 2 1|1Co.2:1;]] οἱ ἐν ὑ (for a parallel to this phrase, see Deiss., BS, 255, and cf. 2Mac, l.with), [[1-timothy 2 2|1Ti.2:2.]]† (AS)
ὑπερ-περισσεύω to abound more exceedingly: [[romans 5 21|Rom.5:21.]] Mid., in same sense (RV, overflow): with dative of thing(s), [[2-corinthians 7 4|2Co.7:4.]]† (AS)
ὑπερ-περισσῶς adv., beyond measure, exceedingly: [[mark 7 37|Mrk.7:37.]]† (AS)
ὑπερ-πλεονάζω to abound exceedingly: [[1-timothy 1 14|1Ti.1:14]] (Ps Sol 5:19; Herm., Mand., v, 2, 5).† (AS)

ὑπερ-υψόω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[psalms 37 35|Psa.37:35]] (עָרִיץ) [[psalms 97 9|Psa.97:9]] (עָלָה ni.), Da TH [[daniel 4 34|Dan.4:34 11:12]] (רוּם), ib. LXX TH [[daniel 3 52|Dan.3:52]] ff.* ;] 1. to exalt beyond measure, exalt to the highest place: [[philippians 2 9|Php.2:9.]] 2. to extol (Da, ll. with).† (AS)

ὑπερ-φρονέω, -ῶ [in LXX: 4Ma.13:1 4Mac 14:11 4Mac 16:2 * ;] 1. to be overproud, high-minded (Æsch.): μὴ ὑ. παρ᾽ ὃ δεῖ φρονεῖν (on the paranom., see Vau., in l), [[romans 12 3|Rom.12:3.]] 2. to overlook, think slightly of (Thuc., Plat.).† (AS)

ὑπερῷον, -ου, τό (neut. of ὑπερῷος, above, ὑπέρ) [in LXX for עֲלִיָּה and cogn. forms ;] 1. in cl., the upper story or upper rooms where the women resided (Hom., a1.). 2. In LXX and NT, an upper chamber, roof-chamber, built on the flat roof of the house (see DB, iii, 674a): [[acts 1 13|Act.1:13 9:37, 39 20:8]] (cf. [[2-kings 23 22|4Ki.23:22]]).† (AS)

ὑπ-έχω [in LXX: [[psalms 89 50|Psa.89:50]] (נָשָׂא), [[lamentations 5 7|La 5:7]] (סָבַל), Wis.12:21, 2Ma.4:48 * ;] to hold or put under. Metaphorical, to undergo, suffer: δίκην, Ju 7 (Soph., Eur., al.).† (AS)

ὑπήκοος, -ον (ὑπακσύω), [in LXX: [[john 17 13|Jhn.17:13]] (לָמַם) [[proverbs 21 28|Pro.21:28]] (שָׁמַע), etc. ;] giving ear, obedient, subject: [[philippians 2 8|Php.2:8;]] with dative of person(s), [[acts 7 39|Act.7:39;]] εἰς πάντα, [[2-corinthians 2 9|2Co.2:9.]]† (AS)

ὑπηρετέω, -ῶ (ὑπηρέτης) [in LXX: Wis.16:21, 24-25 19:6, Sir.39:4 * ;] prop., to serve as rower on a ship (Diod., al.). In cl. always metaphorically, to minister to, serve: with dative of person(s), [[acts 13 36|Act.13:36 20:34 24:23]].† (AS)

ὑπηρέτης, -ου, ὁ (ὑπό + ἐρέτης, a rower) [in LXX: [[proverbs 14 35|Pro.14:35]] (עֶבֶד), Wis.6:4, al. ;] prop., an under rower; hence, generally, a servant, attendant, minister: of a magistrate's attendant, [[matthew 5 25|Mat.5:25;]] of officers of the Synagogue or Sanhedrin, [[matthew 26 58|Mat.26:58]], [[mark 14 54|Mrk.14:54, 65]], [[luke 4 20|Luk.4:20]], [[john 7 32|Jhn.7:32, 45-46 18:3, 12 18:22 19:6]], [[acts 5 22|Act.5:22, 26]]; of the attendants of kings, οἱ ὑ. οἱ ἑμοί [[john 18 36|Jhn.18:36;]] of Christian ministers, [[acts 13 5|Act.13:5 26:16]]; ὑπηρέται λόγου, [[luke 1 2|Luk.1:2;]] Χριστοῦ, [[1-corinthians 4 1|1Co.4:1;]] δοῦλοι κ. ὑ., [[john 18 18|Jhn.18:18.]]† SYN.: see: διάκονος (AS)

ὕπνος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX for שֵׁנָה, חֲלוֹם, etc. ;] sleep: [[matthew 1 24|Mat.1:24]], [[luke 9 32|Luk.9:32]], [[john 11 13|Jhn.11:13]], [[acts 20 9|Act.20:9]]; metaphorically, [[romans 13 11|Rom.13:11.]]† (AS)

ὑπό (before smooth breathing ὑπ᾽, [[matthew 8 9|Mat.8:9]]b, [[luke 7 8|Luk.7:8]]b; before rough breathing ὑφ᾽, [[romans 3 9|Rom.3:9;]] on the neglect of elision in Mt, Lk, ll. witha, [[galatians 3 22|Gal.3:22]], see WH, App., 146; Tdf., Pr., iv), prep. with genitive, dative (not in NT), accusative I. ὑπο-δείκνυμι [in LXX for נָגַד hi., etc. ;] 1. to show secretly. 2. to show by tracing out; hence, generally, to teach, make known: with dative of person(s), [[luke 6 47|Luk.6:47 12:5]], [[acts 9 16|Act.9:16]]; id. with inf., [[matthew 3 7|Mat.3:7]], [[luke 3 7|Luk.3:7]]; before, ὅτι, [[acts 20 35|Act.20:35.]]† (AS)

ὑπο-δέχομαι [in LXX: Tob.7:8-9 Jdth.13:13 A, 1Ma.16:15, 4Ma.13:17 * ;] to receive under one's roof, receive as a guest, entertain hospitably: with accusative of person(s), [[luke 19 6|Luk.19:6]], [[acts 17 7|Act.17:7]], [[james 2 25|Jas.2:25]]; εἰς τ. οἶκον, [[luke 10 38|Luk.10:38]] (see MM, xxv).† (AS)

ὑπο-δέω [in LXX: [[2-chronicles 28 15|2Ch.28:15]], [[ezekiel 16 10|Eze.16:10]] (נָעַל) * ;] to blind under, esp. of foot gear. ὑπόδημα, -τος, τό (ὑποδέω), [in LXX for נָעַל ;] a sole bound under the foot, a sandal: [[matthew 3 11|Mat.3:11 10:10]], [[mark 1 7|Mrk.1:7]], [[luke 3 16|Luk.3:16 10:4 15:22 22:35]], [[john 1 27|Jhn.1:27]]; τ. ποδῶν, [[acts 7 33|Act.7:33]] (LXX) [[acts 13 25|Act.13:25.]]† SYN.: σανδάλιον, q.v (AS)
ὑπόδικος, -ον brought to trial, answerable to: with dative of person(s), τ. θεῷ, [[romans 3 19|Rom.3:19]] (see MM, xxv).† (AS)

ὑπο-ζύγιος, -α, -ον [in LXX for חֲמוֹר ;] under the yoke; as subst., τ . (Hdt., al.), a beast of burden; colloq., an ass (see Deiss., BS, 160 f.), and so always in LXX and NT: [[matthew 21 5|Mat.21:5]] (LXX), [[2-peter 2 16|2Pe.2:16.]]† (AS)
ὑπο-ζώννυμι [in LXX: 2Ma.3:19 * ;] to undergird (Hdt., al.; ὑπὸ τ. μάστους, 2Mac, l.with); of a ship, to undergird or frap: [[acts 27 17|Act.27:17]] (see DB, ext. 367a).† (AS)

ύπο-κάτω comp. adv. (see M, Pr., 99), [in LXX chiefly for תַּחַת ;] below, under: as prep. with genitive, [[matthew 22 44|Mat.22:44]], [[mark 6 11|Mrk.6:11 7:28 12:36]] (Rec., R, txt., ὑποπόδιον, as in LXX), [[luke 8 16|Luk.8:16]], [[john 1 51|Jhn.1:51]], [[hebrews 2 8|Heb.2:8]]" (LXX), [[revelation 5 3|Rev.5:3, 13 6:9 12:1]].† (AS)

ὑπο-κριτής, -οῦ, ὁ (ὑποκρίνομαι, which see) [in LXX [[job 34 30|Job.34:30 36:13]] (חָנֵף) * ;] 1. one who answers, an interpreter (Plat.). 2. a stage player, actor (Plut., Xen., al.). ὑπο-λαμβάνω [in LXX: [[job 2 4|Job.2:4 4:1]] and frequently (עָנָה), [[psalms 48 9|Psa.48:9]] (דָּמָה pi.), Tob.6:17, Wis.17:2, 3Ma.3:8 3Mac 3:11, al. ;] 1. to take or bear up (by supporting from beneath): with accusative of person(s), [[acts 1 9|Act.1:9.]] 2. to receive, welcome, entertain (Xen.): III Jn 8. 3. to catch up in speech (Hdt., al.; Jb, ll. with): [[luke 10 30|Luk.10:30.]] 4. ὑπο-λιμτάνω collat. form of ὑπολείπω, to leave behind: [[1-peter 2 21|1Pe.2:21.]]† (AS)

ὑπο-φέρω [in LXX for נָשָׂא, etc. ;] to bear by being under. Metaphorical, to endure: with accusative of thing(s), [[1-corinthians 10 13|1Co.10:13]], [[2-timothy 3 11|2Ti.3:11]], [[1-peter 2 19|1Pe.2:19]].† (AS)
ὑπο-χωρέω [in LXX: [[judges 20 37|Jdg.20:37]] B (-), Sir.13:9, 2Ma.12:12 * ;] to go back, retire: before ἐν, [[luke 5 16|Luk.5:16;]] before εἰς, [[luke 9 10|Luk.9:10.]]† (AS)
